fab_notes: TEMPER LCR REV G - FABRICATION NOTES
1. Board 100.00 x 110.00 mm, 4 layers, 1.6 mm finished. FR-4, TG 135-140.
2. Stackup JLC04161H-7628: F.Cu 1 oz | 7628 prepreg | In1.Cu 0.5 oz GND plane | core |
In2.Cu 0.5 oz signals + GND pour | 7628 prepreg | B.Cu 1 oz signals + GND pour.
3. Finish ENIG. Solder mask both sides; silkscreen top only (bottom intentionally empty).
4. Vias: every drill 0.30 mm. Covering "Plugged" (JLC default); do NOT order POFV.
Exposed-pad thermal vias in U1, U11, U12, U13, U14: plugged from the bottom only,
top lands left clean and open under paste. No other via touches an SMT land.
5. Drill summary (498 holes; drill files temper-lcr-PTH.drl / -NPTH.drl govern):
vias        38 x 0.30 mm drill, 0.45 mm pad
vias        27 x 0.30 mm drill, 0.55 mm pad
vias       399 x 0.30 mm drill, 0.60 mm pad
PTH          2 x 0.60 x 1.40 mm slot
PTH          2 x 0.60 x 1.70 mm slot
PTH          4 x 1.00 mm
PTH          4 x 1.20 mm
PTH         16 x 1.40 mm
NPTH         2 x 0.60 mm
NPTH         4 x 3.20 mm
6. Panel: edge rails added by JLCPCB, V-cut on the LEFT and RIGHT edges only.
No rail on the front (BNC, y = top in this view) edge or the back edge.
7. Overhang: BNC J3, J7, J8, J9 reach 18.5 mm past the front edge (hand-fitted after
reflow); J1 USB-C shell 0.2 mm past the left edge, >= 0.9 mm above the board.
8. Minimum track / space 0.15 / 0.15 mm; minimum via ring 0.075 mm; copper to edge >= 0.4 mm.
9. Origin (0, 0) at the lower-left board corner for Gerber, drill and placement files.

notes: One PCB; USB-C power (5V, 1A current limit) and USB data; USB-ground referenced.
Install exactly one matching pair of range jumpers with power removed.
OPA2810 analog architecture from TIDA-060029; no BUF634A; feedback closes at actual OPA2810 output.
Engineering prototype; no inherited 0.1% system accuracy. Isolated, discharged DUT only.

Revision C uses one local C104=100pF directly from TIA output to summing input on all ranges, bypassing the RF jumper. C41/C105 removed. Rev C-local100p firmware/calibration identity required; high-range feedback pole15.9kHz reduces sensitivity at100kHz.

Rev C FDA stability: ADS9224REVM SBAU315B feedback topology, 22R inside each feedback loop (EVM uses 10R), 1k || 100pF feedback and 4.32R outside. RGT optional FB pins intentionally NC; external feedback senses after 22R. REFby2 remains directly connected with C74 1uF, rather than EVM per-driver 100R/100nF VOCM branches.
